messages:
nina: Heads-up: compliance team needs a timeboxed export for a regulatory audit (window 2026-05-10T00:00:00Z -> 2026-05-10T06:00:00Z). They asked for 72h retention on the snapshot to allow lawyer review. Can we do that safely?
oscar: Compliance asking long retention is unusual. We should mint a CMK with limited decrypt principals and require a formal retention justification. Also require per-export SALT and PII scrub.
kms-ops: policy check: CMKs with >48h unwrap windows need CISO approval and an audit justification. Recommend ephemeral CMK bound to export with key_usage=ENCRYPT_DECRYPT and key_expiry=96h, but decrypt permission limited to a small principal set.
oncall-ravi: i'm oncall; i can be part of unwrap group but require MFA + attestation in ticket. Also want clear audit hooks for grant, decrypt, and deletion.
infra-sam: infra can create an export workflow that stores encrypted snapshot in s3://compliance-exports/<ticket>/, with lifecycle rule to expire at retention TTL. We can also restrict S3 ACLs and bucket policy to deny GetObject unless KMS decrypt principal and during unwrap window.
nina: proposed rules: user_id -> sha256(user_id + SALT), email -> redact, ip -> mask /24, remove oauth tokens. Per-export SALT stored in vault://sec/COM-3321/salt. Export encrypted with CMK alias/al_compliance_3321. Retention: 72h. Decrypt allowed only for principals: infra-sam, oncall-ravi, sec-aud. MFA required.
sec-aud: we can accept 72h if CISO signs off and the ticket documents legal reasoning. auditors require that the export lifecycle is automatic and deletion emits an audit event. Also require per-export justification stored in ticket.
oscar: please add an infra PR to create a temporary role "compliance-audit-viewer" scoped to that single export prefix and duration 72h, not broad SIEM read.
infra-sam: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3015 - adds role and bucket policy to deny reads outside unwrap window. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
nina: SIEM query (approx):
```
index=auth_events earliest="2026-05-10T00:00:00Z" latest="2026-05-10T06:00:00Z" | fields user_id,email,ip,event,timestamp
```
Scrub rules: user_id -> sha256+salt, email->"[redacted]", ip->mask_last_octet, drop auth_token.
kms-ops: file KMS request KMS-1509 for CMK alias/al_compliance_3321 with key_policy limiting Decrypt to the role and oncall principal. CISO approval required for 72h decrypt window.
sec-aud: add vault entry for SALT and confirm no secrets in PR. Also require a signed attestation checkbox in ticket before any unwrap.
oncall-ravi: i'll do the attestation when asked. include exact steps for unwrap in the ticket so I can copy/paste.
infra-sam: PR merged. KMS-1509 filed. waiting on CISO and KMS-ops to approve.
kms-ops: CISO signoff logged. KMS-1509 approved with expiry 96h but Decrypt allowed only during the 72h window noted in ticket.
sec-aud: final approval granted. Conditions: 1) SALT in vault 2) audit hooks for grant/decrypt/delete 3) MFA unwrap and attestation 4) S3 lifecycle configured.
nina: adding SALT to vault://sec/COM-3321/salt and creating ticket COM-3321. kicking export now. job id=C-775. snapshot path s3://compliance-exports/COM-3321/C-775.json.enc. unwrap window starts 2026-05-10T00:10:00Z for 72h.
oscar: monitoring auditlog for events. Please tag me once download occurs.
oncall-ravi: performed MFA unwrap and downloaded snapshot; verified scrub applied. audit entries seen: grant#COM-3321, decrypt#C-775, download#C-775.
sec-aud: verified audit trail and SALT usage. scheduling automatic deletion at 2026-05-13T00:10:00Z.
nina: export complete. follow-ups: add a compliance export template and require CISO approval in playbook. thanks everyone.
sec-aud: closing thread; postmortem and retention justification attached to COM-3321.
